# SnapTrace
> A featherweight (<5KB), noise-free error tracking and crash telemetry platform built for Next.js, React, Node, and modern web applications. An independent, lightweight alternative to Sentry and Datadog.

## Core Architectural Differentiators
- Bundle Footprint: Sub-5KB client SDK (<3.4KB gzipped) with zero dependencies.
- Zero-Delay Telemetry: Dispatches asynchronously via native navigator.sendBeacon with 0.0ms main-thread delay (zero penalty on Google Core Web Vitals and INP).
- Client-Side Privacy: On-device regex AST firewall that sanitizes passwords, authorization tokens, credit cards, and emails before network transit.
- Alert Noise Suppression: In-memory 60-second sliding-window deduplication that collapses 50 runaway re-render crashes into a single [x50] beacon.
- Cascading Outage Collapse: Groups multi-error symptom cascades into a single root-cause incident.
- 1-Click AI Fix Prompts: Exports structured debugging prompts tailored for Cursor, Claude Code, and VS Code Copilot.

## Pricing & Tiers
- Developer Free: $0/month (2,000 events/mo, 1 project, 7-day retention)
- Pro Builder: $19/month or $15/month billed annually (75,000 events/mo, up to 5 projects, Discord/Slack alerts, Cursor AI fixes)
- Agency Studio: $49/month or $39/month billed annually (500,000 events/mo, unlimited projects, cascading outage collapse, team seats)
